sections.h2: How social media automation for small business works
sections.html:
Most owners do not need someone to post for them forever. They need a system light enough to keep going. So we build this social media automation service once, around your brand, and then it is yours.

A normal week for your team:

  • The 30-day calendar already says what this week's posts are about.
  • The AI assistant drafts them in your voice, in English, Vietnamese or both.
  • One person reads each draft and approves it. Nothing is published without that yes.
  • Approved posts are scheduled automatically. Common inbox questions get an automatic reply, and complaints still go to a person.

What we do not do: post on your behalf every day, or run ads. Platform features vary by account and change over time, so we set up what your accounts support. See social media automation for nail salons and social media automation for restaurants.

sections.h2: Why Facebook, Instagram and TikTok automation starts with your brand
sections.html:
An AI assistant can only sound like you if it knows who you are. Without a clear brand voice it guesses, and your posts read like every other page in your industry.

That is why the automation is an add-on to the Start, Build or Refresh package. The brand work gives the AI what it needs:

  • Positioning: who you are for and how you are different. This shapes your calendar's themes.
  • Story and key messages: the things worth repeating, in your own words.
  • Voice and guidelines: how you speak and how your posts should look.

For Vietnamese owners abroad, our page on marketing for Vietnamese businesses overseas explains the brand side. To plan a month yourself, read our guide to an AI content calendar for small business.

process.title: Six steps, and you approve each one

items.p: A 60-minute conversation. We listen to the founder's story: why you started, what you believe in, which customers you want to reach and what you want from the business. We note the words you use.

Who the brand is, who it is for, how it is different. We analyse your competitors in depth to see where you stand and which direction to take next, based on what the founder wants, then write the key messages that become calendar themes.

We work directly with the founder and the person in charge of the brand: logo, colours, typography and voice. We agree on every part together and pack it into guidelines, so the brand can be built over the long term. The AI assistant learns this voice.

Once customers start to recognise the brand, we take it where they already go: website, signage, cards, social media (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, LinkedIn, Zalo, Pinterest) and the media channels they follow. If you already have channels, we read their data, customer behaviour and past campaign results, then advise you on a strategy for new campaigns. The automation is added here.

A brand that grows without a community behind it is not yet a successful brand, and repeat purchases from a good community save a lot of sales and marketing spend. We help you build your community on the platforms your customers prefer, so they stay loyal.

Every brand meets a communication crisis at some point. Our team specialises in studying and handling crises, keeps the impact and risk to your brand as small as possible, and trains your team to respond the way communication professionals do.

faq.q: Do you post for us or run our ads?
faq.a: No. We build the system and your own team runs it, approving each draft before it is scheduled. We do not post on your behalf every day and we do not run ads.

faq.q: Can I get the automation without a brand package?
faq.a: It is an add-on to Start, Build or Refresh, because the AI needs a clear brand voice to sound like you. Already have a logo you like? Refresh keeps what works.

faq.q: Will the content be in English and Vietnamese?
faq.a: Yes, if your customers need both. We work in Vietnamese and English. See our guide to bilingual marketing for Vietnamese businesses abroad.
We do not name tools here: the right setup depends on your accounts and what your team finds easy. We only set up what your accounts support.
The quote comes after the first conversation: 60 minutes, online or in person. Email hello@bunchasake.com to start.
